skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury]. [Internal Injury]: Deals 100% of Bomb’s ATK when the affected target is attacked and disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 6 consecutive strikes, dealing 510% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 500% of Bomb’s ATK when the affected target is attacked and disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 6 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 750% of Bomb’s ATK when the affected target is attacked and disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains a 60% chance of [Evade] for 5 rounds. After any character acts, absorbs 40% of the [Internal Injury] DMG on enemies and deals [Specialized Extra DMG] to the entire enemy team. For the first 5 rounds, before any character acts, recovers HP equal to 500% of ATK, up to 3 times per round. [Evade]: Reduces Direct, Extra, Charge, and Berserk DMG to 1 DMG. [Specialized Extra DMG]: Can CRIT and is not affected by [Specialized DMG Reflect].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains a 70% chance of [Evade] for 8 rounds. After any character acts, absorbs 50% of the [Internal Injury] DMG on enemies and deals [Specialized Extra DMG] to the entire enemy team. For the first 5 rounds, before any character acts, recovers HP equal to 650% of ATK, up to 4 times per round. [Evade]: Reduces Direct, Extra, Charge, and Berserk DMG to 1 DMG. [Specialized Extra DMG]: Can CRIT and is not affected by [Specialized DMG Reflect].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains a 70% chance of [Evade] for 8 rounds. After any character acts, absorbs 60% of the [Internal Injury] DMG on enemies and deals [Specialized Extra DMG] to the entire enemy team. For the first 5 rounds, before any character acts, recovers HP equal to 650% of ATK, up to 4 times per round. [Evade]: Reduces Direct, Extra, Charge, and Berserk DMG to 1 DMG. [Specialized Extra DMG]: Can CRIT and is not affected by [Specialized DMG Reflect].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When Bomb attacks, summons Silverfang to perform a [Combo Attack] using the same attack style. Basic: Deals 100% of Bomb’s ATK as DMG to a random target. Ultimate: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 150% of Bomb’s ATK as DMG, and has a 75% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 450% of Bomb’s ATK when the affected target is attacked and disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When Bomb attacks, summons Silverfang to perform a [Combo Attack] using the same attack style. Basic: Deals 100% of Bomb’s ATK as DMG to a random target. Ultimate: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 200% of Bomb’s ATK as DMG, and has a 90% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target. [Internal Injury]: Deals 600% of Bomb’s ATK when the affected target is attacked and disappears after triggering.
